acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:ec34a1ac-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. We're looking for a Founding Account Executive to launch Vanta's downmarket business across Latin America. This is a unique opportunity to build a market from the ground up. As one of the first sellers in the region, you'll help shape our go-to-market strategy, establish repeatable sales motions, and lay the foundation for future growth. You'll own the full sales cycle across a diverse customer base - from founder-led startups to fast-growing businesses - balancing high-velocity, self-sourced opportunities with more complex deals. Vanta is at a pivotal moment. We've surpassed $300M ARR and continue to outpace our growth targets while maintaining industry-leading customer satisfaction. As we expand our global footprint, this role offers the chance to make an outsized impact on both our business and your career. If you're excited by the opportunity to build something from scratch, thrive in ambiguity, and want to help define Vanta's next chapter in Latin America, we'd love to hear from you. What you’ll do as a Founding AE at Vanta: - Own the end-to-end sales cycle for downmarket accounts (0-400 employees) across Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, and Chile - Run fast and dynamic deal cycles independently - Build and execute outbound strategies to generate pipeline across core LatAm markets, working closely with a dedicated SDR - Convert inbound demand into closed-new business, while driving the majority of pipeline through self-sourced outbound - Define and communicate the specific benefits of Vanta appropriate for each customer, including building sales materials and running demos in Spanish - Help lay the sales playbook and go-to-market foundation for Vanta's expansion into Spanish-speaking LatAm - Collect insights from prospects for our product development process How to be successful in this role: - Full native fluency in Spanish, with Portuguese a major plus - Direct experience selling into LatAm markets - 5+ years of full-cycle, quota-carrying closing experience, including a transactional/high-velocity sales background, even if your recent roles have skewed toward larger deals - Experience in a founding AE or early-market-building role strongly preferred - Proven ability to self-source pipeline through outbound prospecting and cold outreach; comfortable being the primary driver of your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound - An entrepreneurial, "figure-it-out" mindset with a strong sense of ownership over your territory - Experience in B2B SaaS; a background in cyber/GRC is a plus but not required - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship; East or Central time zone strongly preferred What you can expect as a Vanta’n: - Industry-competitive salary and equity - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents - Health & wellness stipend - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office - Family

aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:819.title: Security Officer Part-Time (L.A. LIVE)
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:819.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! L.A. LIVE is a vibrant 4 million square foot entertainment destination located in the heart of downtown Los Angeles. It is a place that truly captures the essence of the city's lively and dynamic atmosphere. L.A. LIVE offers a wide array of entertainment options, including world-class music venues, a sports and entertainment arena, restaurants, clubs and hotels. It is located adjacent to Crypto.com Arena and the Los Angeles Convention Center and features venues including The Novo, a 2,300 capacity live music venue, Peacock Theater, a 7,100-seat live theatre, a 54-story, 1001-room convention "headquarters" destination (including The Ritz-Carlton, Los Angeles and JW Marriott Los Angeles at L.A. LIVE hotels and 224 luxury condominiums – The Ritz-Carlton Residences at L.A. LIVE – all in a single tower), the 14-screen Regal Cinemas L.A. LIVE theatre, broadcast facilities for ESPN, along with entertainment, residential, restaurant and office space. Developed by Los Angeles-based AEG, L.A. LIVE is considered to be the nation's most active “live content and event campus.” It features 260,480 square feet of conference center and ballroom facilities, a 100,000 square foot special events deck, the famous Lucky Strike Lanes and Lounge, a one-of-a-kind GRAMMY Museum, saluting the history of music and the genre's best-known awards show all centered around Peacock Place, a 40,000 square foot outdoor event space. L.A. LIVE showcases more events, award shows, sporting competitions, concerts and hospitality options than any other destination in the world. If you are looking for a bite to eat, L.A. LIVE has an impressive selection of restaurants and bars offering diverse cuisines and atmospheres. From upscale dining options to casual eateries, you'll find something to suit your taste buds. To top it off, L.A. LIVE also offers hotel options for those looking to stay in the heart of the action. Whether you're just visiting Los Angeles or hoping to stay following a concert, a sporting event, or simply looking to explore the city, L.A. LIVE has everything you need to make the experience memorable. Job Summary: Security Officer provides safety, security, and customer service to the guests, tenants, and employees of the L.A. LIVE project, The GRAMMY Museum, and to the South Park Business/Community Benefit District. Security Officers employed by AEG will assist local public safety agencies in the performance of their duties in providing service to the surrounding community as it affects L.A. LIVE. Essential Functions: Serve as a representative and liaison of L.A. LIVE, while demonstrating a professional, positive, polite, and friendly attitude. Tact and discretion must always be used in all interactions with campus guests and employees. Patrol campus on foot and bicycle or PMV in some cases in and surrounding the facility. Respond quickly to all security needs and calls for service. Provide customer service to all patrons and employees.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:22639a57-d838-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Project Manager based in India. This is an opportunity to lead complex, high-visibility projects from initial planning through successful delivery and handover. You will work across multiple workstreams, balancing strategic priorities with budgets, resources, timelines, and operational requirements. The role requires strong executive presence and the ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and C-level leaders. You will apply both Agile and Waterfall methodologies to adapt delivery approaches to each project’s needs. Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, forecasting, financial analysis, resource allocation, and cost control. Advanced knowledge of Agile and Waterfall project management methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban. Experience working directly with senior stakeholders, executives, and C-level leadership. This role offers the opportunity to manage international influencer marketing campaigns from planning through execution and performance analysis. You will serve as a key point of contact for creators while ensuring campaigns remain organized, on-brand, and aligned with client objectives. The position combines account management, creator relations, content quality control, campaign operations, and data analysis. You will work across multiple campaigns and markets, identifying opportunities to improve performance and build stronger creator partnerships. Your attention to detail will be essential when reviewing content, tracking deliverables, and maintaining accurate campaign information. The role is well suited to an organized, analytical professional who enjoys working with influencers, data, and fast-moving digital marketing campaigns. You will also have the opportunity to discover high-performing creators and contribute to the growth of international influencer programs. Manage day-to-day communication and relationships with international influencers and content creators. Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Our partner is looking for a Senior Accounting Manager / Controller based in United States. This is a foundational accounting leadership role within a fast-growing, AI-driven business environment. You will own the accounting function and establish the financial infrastructure needed to support the company’s next stage of growth. The role combines hands-on ownership of the close, financial reporting, controls, compliance, and accounting operations with opportunities to modernize processes through automation and AI. You will work closely with finance and senior leadership, providing reliable financial insights for operational and strategic decisions. As the accounting function evolves, you will have the opportunity to build systems, processes, and a high-performing team from the ground up. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced accounting professional who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment and wants visible impact. Own the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close processes, ensuring timely and accurate GAAP-compliant financial statements suitable for leadership, board, and investor reporting. Design and manage an AI-enabled finance technology stack, evaluating accounting systems and identifying opportunities to automate workflows and improve efficiency. Build sophisticated reporting and financial processes that provide leadership with dependable data and greater visibility into business performance. Recruit, mentor, and develop accounting team members as the function expands, establishing a strong culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement. Demonstrated experience managing month-end and year-end close processes, preparing financial statements, and supporting or completing external audits. Proven ability to build and improve accounting processes and infrastructure within an early-stage or rapidly scaling organization. Strong financial modeling, analytical, and data-management capabilities, with the ability to work confidently with large datasets. Experience automating accounting workflows, developing reporting solutions, and integrating financial systems is highly valued. Ability to evaluate and implement technology and AI tools that improve accounting accuracy, efficiency, and scalability. Strong organizational and project management skills, with exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to financial accuracy. Our partner is looking for a Director, Business Development based in Canada. This is a high-visibility leadership opportunity to build and scale a strategic partnerships function within a fast-growing restaurant technology business. You will identify and develop partnerships that expand revenue, accelerate customer acquisition, and unlock new market opportunities.
